    if not resp:

    for pl in resp:

            all_song_ids.add(sid)

    pi+=1

page_limit_reviews=20

    i=0
    reviews=[]
    while True:
        r=apis.spotify.show_song_reviews(song_id=sid,user_email=user_email,min_rating=1,max_rating=5,page_index=i,page_limit=page_limit_reviews,sort_by='-created_at')

        i+=1

    if len(reviews)==0:
        songs_to_create.append(sid)
